 School Holiday Tomorrow, November 20, 2026: Schools closed in Odisha due to cyclonic storm Akvan; Check state-wise updates
 SECTIONS School Holiday Tomorrow, November 20, 2026: Schools closed in Odisha due to cyclonic storm Akvan; Check state-wise updates By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 19, 2026, 06:02:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis On November 20, 2026, schools in Delhi, Bihar, Tamil Nadu, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh are expected to remain open. Odisha schools will be closed due to Cyclonic Storm Akvan affecting certain districts. Parents and students in these states should verify school operations through official channels and notifications. Local weather conditions will influence school closures and announcements in some regions.
 Agencies School Holiday Tomorrow, November 20, 2026: Schools closed in Odisha due to cyclonic storm Akvan; Check state-wise updates
 School Holiday Tomorrow , November 20, 2026 : Parents and students across India are checking whether schools will remain open or closed on Friday amid changing weather conditions and local administrative updates. From Delhi-NCR to Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha, West Bengal and other states, school authorities may announce holidays depending on weather alerts, government orders and local circumstances. Check the state-wise school holiday updates for November 20 to know whether schools will remain open or closed.

 Delhi School Holiday Tomorrow 
 Schools across Delhi are expected to remain open on Friday, November 20, as no official order announcing a citywide school holiday has been issued so far. Following the revocation of GRAP Stage-III restrictions, schools have resumed regular offline classes for all students. However, parents should check their respective school WhatsApp groups, official websites and circulars for any last-minute changes, particularly in view of air pollution concerns.
 Bihar School Holiday Tomorrow 
chools across Bihar are expected to remain open on Friday, November 20, as no fresh statewide order announcing a school holiday has been reported so far. The extended Diwali and Chhath Puja holidays have ended, and schools are expected to resume regular academic activities.
 Live Events
 Tamil Nadu School Holiday Tomorrow 
 Schools across Tamil Nadu are expected to remain open on Friday, November 20, as no statewide school holiday has been announced for the day. However, schools in districts affected by heavy rainfall may announce local closures depending on weather conditions and instructions from district collectors. Parents and students should check their respective school notices for the latest updates.
 Odisha School Holiday Tomorrow 
 Schools across several districts of Odisha will remain closed on Friday, November 20, as a precautionary measure amid Cyclonic Storm Akvan. The state government has announced holidays for all government, government-aided and private schools in Ganjam, Gajapati, Puri, Jagatsinghpur, Kendrapara and Kandhamal from November 19 to 21. Schools in Khordha, Malkangiri, Rayagada and Koraput will also remain closed on November 20.
 Rajasthan School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Rajasthan are expected to remain open on Friday, November 20, as no statewide school holiday has been announced for the day. The mid-term vacation observed from November 4 to November 15 has ended, and regular academic activities resumed on November 16.
 Himachal Pradesh School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Himachal Pradesh are expected to remain open on Friday, November 20, as no statewide school holiday has been announced for the day. According to the state's 2026 holiday calendar, November 20 is not listed as a gazetted holiday.
 West Bengal School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across West Bengal are expected to remain open on Friday, November 20, as no statewide school closure has been announced for the day. November 20 is not listed as a school holiday in the West Bengal Board of Secondary Education's 2026 model holiday calendar. However, private, CBSE and ICSE-affiliated schools may follow different academic schedules. Parents and students should check their respective school notices for any last-minute changes.
